chart-broker.name: Chart Broker Ilsa

lines: Ilsa: Fresh off the boat, eh? Everyone charts the Saturn system free — memorize it, the moons move.
Ilsa: Here — Jupiter jump coordinates, burned into your plotter. The beacon chain out there is dark, so don't hurry.
